reason: noreplace-smp (UP lock-prefix patching) was removed in the 7.3 cycle; 7.3 would log it as an
unknown parameter and hand it to init. Lock prefixes are always kept now.

comment: FIPS canister series ported to Linux 7.3 (fips-7.3 in the kernel directory of the release branch;
manifest.json says which file each PatchN/SourceN names, which patches 7.x does not need,
and the %autopatch ranges; the port's %prep replay and rpmbuild -bp verified it).
Only for a canister build: CANISTER_MODE build builds the canister with linux and links
it into linux-esx; equivalent-a/equivalent-b are sharukhan's two phases. CANISTER_MODE
none leaves the kernel FIPS-off. No canister of this series is published, so nothing
built this way is CMVP validated.

kernel_patches.applied: RAP/KCFI Patch61 (7.3 rebase) and Patch63 enabled
comment: RAP/KCFI ("Secure" range) for the generic linux flavor: Patch61 points at the
7.3 rebase in secure/ on the experimental/linux-7.3 branch, Patch63 (PAX
tasklet fix) applies as is. Patch62 (objtool: return error) stays off: it no longer
applies, and RAP builds emit objtool "no-cfi indirect call!" notes it would make fatal.
Runs after disable_unrebased_ranges, which comments out every %autopatch each pass.
kernel_patches.label: RAP
kernel_patches.name: rap

comment: rdrand hwrng driver (Patch6) for both flavors: systemd's 10-rdrand-rng.conf loads
rdrand-rng and both configs set HW_RANDOM_RDRAND=m. disable_unrebased_ranges deletes
Patch2-Patch49, so re-add Patch6 pointing at the 7.3 rebase in vmw/ and apply it.
kernel_patches.label: rdrand hwrng driver
kernel_patches.name: rdrand

comment: vmwgfx blend mode (Patch7300) for both flavors: 7.3's DRM core warns for every plane
with alpha formats but no blend mode property; the patch declares PREMULTI.
kernel_patches.label: vmwgfx blend mode
kernel_patches.name: vmwgfx

summary: RAP/KCFI on, rdrand-rng, vmwgfx blend, noreplace-smp dropped, esx BTF off, STIG initrd restore, FIPS canister for canister builds; kernel in the tree's kernel directory
